newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 10-yr notes seen yielding 6.73-74 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 10-yr notes seen yielding 6.73-74 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $12.0 billion in 10-year notes on Wednesday should produce a yield around 6.73 to 6.74 percent, with a possible one basis point tail, dealers said.
Shortly before the bidding deadline of 1300 EDT/1700 GMT, the 10-year notes were trading with a when-issued yield of 6.725 percent.
Results for the auction are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
